failure_patterns.pattern: answer_format: The entity was identified, but the answer used the wrong name boundary or form: an expanded name, a nickname, or only part of a title.

rejected_edits.content: When a clue says a parody, adaptation, or other work changed part of an earlier title, distinguish the original title from the altered title. If the answer slot asks for the source work or calls it the original author's title, give the canonical original title; give the changed version only when that version is requested.
rejected_edits.target: ## Use the Conventional Name at the Requested Scope

rejected_edits.content: When context gives spelling or transliteration variants, prefer the form most directly tied to the clue's distinguishing wording or property. Do not choose an alternative merely because it appears first or in a document title; use a variant only when the evidence does not establish a more relevant form.
rejected_edits.target: For proper names and titles, use the conventional form that identifies the requested entity. Do not substitute a nickname or later brand name for the historically relevant label, omit words from a work's title when the work is requested, or add optional middle names. Conversely, when the clue requests a generic class, do not embellish it with a narrower associated name.
